Thank you for your email.

At your disposal

statement: Booking-system confirmation: brokers confirm the reservation in the shared booking system (mmk) and then we send the confirmation documents in a separate email.
Bavaria C38 'Alfonso' is in our Lefkada fleet (broker option for 12 Sep 2026; agreed final client price 3,225 EUR with outboard and 1 SUP free). No other specs in this thread.

Broker price negotiation: for a Bavaria C38 booking we first refused an extra discount, offered the outboard free, then offered the SUP free as a goodwill gesture. Final client price agreed 3,225 EUR.

Brokers ask for a booking confirmation for the broker, a booking confirmation for the client (no commission mentioned), contract and base info. When the broker's payment is international, allocation can take a couple of days. Commission percentage is not stated: not found - please confirm.

Damage waiver is an on-spot option handled at check-in at the office: non-refundable amount (400 EUR for a Bavaria 56) paid by card; the 1,000 EUR refundable amount is a pre-authorisation on a crew member's card and can also be insured.
Isla 40 'RIH' has air conditioning in every cabin and a generator but no watermaker.

Broker price negotiation: 'We are not able to offer an additional discount' on a Bavaria C38 booking for 12 Sept 2026, but outboard was given free; then SUP also offered free 'as a gesture of goodwill'. Final broker client price 3,225 EUR with outboard and one SUP free.

Lagoon 40 Imeroessa: catamaran, 2022, base Lefkada / Port of Lefkas, 40 ft, 10 berths (8 in cabins + 2 in saloon), 5 cabins (4 double + 1 bow), 4 WC/shower, full batten. Selling points: A/C in every cabin, lithium batteries, generator.

Special deal for a broker on Lagoon 40 Imeroessa (5-12 Sep 2026): list 8,400 EUR, offered at 6,100 EUR gross (-27.38%), 5,116.13 EUR after -20% commission. Team gave an extra 400 EUR discount and asked the broker to cover the remaining 300 EUR (extra discount deducted from the broker's commission). Broker's client price was 5,800 EUR plus extras.

Broker options come through Booking Manager (option request email with expiry date, e.g. option for 5-12 Sep 2026 expiring 02.03.2026). Brokers write to info@ and we reply with the offer and an option confirmation attached. Broker commission is deducted at -20% in the quoted total.

Damage waiver is chosen on the spot at check-in at the office. 400 EUR non-refundable, paid by card; 1,000 EUR refundable is a pre-authorisation on a crew member's card, and it can also be insured. (Bavaria 56 booking.)

Broker partner agencies (Ionian Charter style) send booking confirmations with a reference code and ask us to return a signed copy; we confirm and send booking documents in a separate email. Charter party for partner bookings is completed at our office.
Bali 4.1 'Ramon' (catamaran, base Lefkada / Port of Lefkas): hard-bottom dinghy, 4 WC/toilets in total, bow cabin suitable for a skipper but compact and mainly for crew use.

Bali 4.1 'Ramon' option for 12-19 Sept 2026 (embark 17:00, disembark 09:00): base price EUR 7,550, discount EUR 2,230.90, total EUR 5,319.10 (option quoted by system). The broker's client price on booking was EUR 6,260.
For a broker booking on the Bavaria 56 we offered an additional 5% discount after a phone conversation (Feb 2026), and the broker then confirmed the booking.

Damage Waiver on the Bavaria 56 is an on-spot option at check-in in the office: EUR 400 non-refundable paid by card, plus EUR 1,000 refundable as a pre-authorisation on a crew member's card; the refundable amount can also be insured.

A copy of the skipper licence is needed 7 days before arrival, and it must be valid and acceptable to the port authorities. For a Romanian permit we asked for confirmation that it covers sailing craft (category S) and its validity in our area; the broker answered that it is an official permit issued by Romanian authorities valid worldwide.

Damage Waiver for Bavaria 56 (Feb 2026): on-spot option at check-in at the office. 400 EUR non-refundable paid by card, plus 1,000 EUR refundable as a pre-authorization on a crew member's card. The refundable part can also be insured.

For broker booking Bavaria 56 03-17.10.2026, we granted an additional 5% discount after a phone conversation (offer email subject 'Regarding your Option'). The charter party for broker bookings is completed at our office. Balance reminders are sent by Thomais, then Ileana (3 days before start).

Broker discount practice (Georgios Katsifis, 5 Feb 2026, quoted): after a phone conversation we offered a broker an additional 5% discount on a booking (Ionian Charter, Bavaria 56/2016, 3-17 October 2026 Lefkas). The broker then confirmed the booking the same day and sent a booking confirmation for us to fill in and sign.
Our team offered an additional 5% discount on a broker booking (Ionian Charter, Bavaria 56/2016, 3-17.10.2026) after a phone conversation, subject to the broker confirming it works for their guest.

Broker option on Idal (Lagoon 42, 2021, Lefkada, 6 cabins, A/C every cabin, generator, watermaker) for 05.09 to 12.09.2026: option expiry reminder sent 06.02.2026 with an additional 5% discount to confirm; broker confirmed next day and asked for booking confirmation in the name of the person while the contract is with the broker's company. Security deposit 4,000 EUR, end cleaning 370 EUR, damage waiver 400 non-refundable.

Broker option on Lagoon 42 Idal (5-12.9.2026) was sent as 'Your Option on our Idal!' on 2026-02-01; option reminder on 2026-02-04 said it expires 06.02.2026 and offered an additional 5% discount; broker confirmed 05.02 and was told booking documents follow in a separate email.

Offers state 'Skipper licence required' for bareboat. For a broker client we checked a Romanian ICMS permit: the 'S - sailing craft' category was not shown in the category part, so we asked for confirmation of validity for our area; broker replied it is an official permit valid worldwide, and we acknowledged.
